decision.authority: owner ca37b94e-5757-4878-811c-907915e18161; primary retained-homepage review under article-only scope
decision.rationale: The Vancouver-based Behavioral Sustainability Lab homepage provides substantive research, publications, people, media and event material on psychological approaches to financial and environmental sustainability.
evidence: https://zhaolab.psych.ubc.ca/ | 410c98b6d3207d153a43ea1b5d55a0e0253f4f48f104834103f1b47db5afb1f0 | We use psychological principles and insights to design behavioral solutions to solve financial and environmental sustainability challenges.

https://zhaolab.psych.ubc.ca/ | 410c98b6d3207d153a43ea1b5d55a0e0253f4f48f104834103f1b47db5afb1f0 | We do so by running field and lab experiments to promote behavior change in resource conservation, waste reduction, climate mitigation, and financial independence.

https://zhaolab.psych.ubc.ca/ | 410c98b6d3207d153a43ea1b5d55a0e0253f4f48f104834103f1b47db5afb1f0 | Crucially, our work demonstrates the value of psychology in addressing urgent societal problems and informing the design and implementation of public policy.

rules.rationale: The People section profiles lab members.
The Media section presents news coverage, talks, films and books.
The Events section presents lab happenings and participation moments.

fallback.rationale: The host primarily presents laboratory research and publications.
